header: What the dispatch desk settles before 08:00
subheadline: At 06:00: two sick calls, a broken-down van and a chiller failure in Wels. These four things are settled before the first crew leaves.

items.title: Reassign without phoning around
items.description: Drag a job to another technician and the app updates in under two seconds. Nobody is called twice or drives to a job already covered.

items.title: Watch the SLA deadline
items.description: Each job shows its contracted response window. The board warns 30 minutes before a breach, while there is still time to send someone.

items.title: See van stock before promising a part
items.description: Van stock is counted when each job closes. The dispatcher knows if the compressor is 15 minutes or three days away before agreeing a time.

items.title: Hand over the shift in writing
items.description: The evening handover lists open calls, parts on order and anything the night crew takes over. The board creates it, so nobody types it from memory.
